xat.ability.clear_splash.name: Clear Waters
xat.ability.clear_splash.tooltip1: Blocks the water splash screen effect
xat.ability.clear_vision.name: Clear Eyes
xat.ability.clear_vision.tooltip1: Blocks the explosion blur screen effect
xat.ability.climbing.name: Climbing
xat.ability.climbing.tooltip1: Climb walls at $speed: blocks/s while airborne; sneak to hang still; no fall distance builds up; blocked by a ceiling
xat.ability.climbing.tooltip2: $whitelist:Only listed blocks are climbable ($count: entries, incl. tags and wildcards)
xat.ability.climbing.tooltip3: $blacklist:Every block except the listed ones ($count: entries) is climbable
xat.ability.creative_flight.name: §6Flying
xat.ability.creative_flight.tooltip1: Double tap jump to start or stop flying
xat.ability.creative_flight.tooltip2: Costs $cost: MP per second while flying; flight is revoked when mana runs out
xat.ability.creative_flight.tooltip4: No fall distance builds up while flying; immune to $levitation:; no mining slowdown while airborne
xat.ability.dodging.name: Dodging
xat.ability.dodging.tooltip1: $doubletap:Double tap a movement key on the ground to dodge that way ($speed: blocks/tick)
xat.ability.dodging.tooltip2: $keymode:Hold *key: and press a movement key on the ground to dodge that way ($speed: blocks/tick)
xat.ability.dodging.tooltip3: Each dodge costs $cost: MP with a $cooldown:s cooldown; cannot dodge while sneaking
xat.ability.dodging.tooltip4: Dodging inflicts $paralysis: for $stun:s on creatures within $radius: blocks
xat.ability.dodging.tooltip5: $external:With Elenai Dodge or Talents installed, their dodge (Sidestep) triggers these effects and costs the mana instead
xat.ability.elytra_flight.name: §6Elytra Flight
xat.ability.elytra_flight.tooltip1: Press jump while falling to glide without an elytra (vanilla elytra physics); ends on landing, in water, while riding or levitating
xat.ability.elytra_flight.tooltip2: Costs $cost: MP per second while gliding
xat.ability.elytra_flight.tooltip3: Press jump while gliding to gain $lift: blocks/tick of lift for $liftcost: MP
xat.ability.elytra_flight.tooltip4: $liftfree:Press jump while gliding to gain $lift: blocks/tick of lift for free
xat.ability.elytra_flight.tooltip5: Right-click with a firework while gliding to boost (consumes the firework)
xat.ability.elytra_flight.tooltip6: $collision:Flying into a wall at speed hurts, like a vanilla elytra
xat.ability.ender_eyes.name: Ender Eyes
xat.ability.ender_eyes.tooltip1: Blocks the Enderman static screen effect
xat.ability.ender_queen.name: §5Ender Royalty
xat.ability.ender_queen.teleport.failed: §cSomething Prevents you from moving through the void.
xat.ability.ender_queen.tooltip1: $ignore: chance to completely ignore an attack from a living attacker
xat.ability.ender_queen.tooltip10: Touching water or rain costs $watercost: MP per second; without mana it deals $waterdamage: damage ($waterdamageeye: with a Dragon's Eye)
xat.ability.ender_queen.tooltip11: Creatures within $blockradius: blocks (±$blockheight: vertically) cannot teleport with ender powers, pearls or chorus fruit (except in water; players only with PvP on)
xat.ability.ender_queen.tooltip2: $spawn: chance to summon an Enderman that fights your attacker
xat.ability.ender_queen.tooltip4: $teleport: chance to teleport up to $range: blocks away when hit by indirect damage (projectiles etc.), costing $hurtcost: of max MP; right-click the item to toggle
xat.ability.ender_queen.tooltip5: Press *key: to teleport randomly up to $range: blocks away for $activecost: of max MP
xat.ability.ender_queen.tooltip6: $chest:Press *aux: + *key: to open your Ender Chest, costing 100% of max MP (mana must be full)
xat.ability.frost_walker.name: §bFrost Walker
xat.ability.frost_walker.tooltip1: Walking on the ground turns water within $radius: blocks into $ice: and lava into $magma: (+1 radius per Frost Walker level, up to $max:); both melt later
xat.ability.greedy_eyes.name: §aGreedy Eyes
xat.ability.greedy_eyes.tooltip1: Press *key: for the next treasure target, *aux: + *key: for the previous ($count: targets)
xat.ability.greedy_eyes.tooltip2: Scans for the target within $horizontal: blocks horizontally and $vertical: vertically every $interval:s
xat.ability.greedy_eyes.tooltip4: Marks up to $points: locations with particles
xat.ability.greedy_eyes.tooltip5: Each scan costs $cost: MP; turns off when mana runs out
xat.ability.greedy_eyes.tooltip6: A dragon growl hints at the closest target $growl: (louder when closer, silent beyond $growlrange: blocks)
xat.ability.greedy_eyes.treasurefinder.n: §6I'm unsure what my treasury currently needs. §c(Item not found, returned as $target:)
xat.ability.greedy_eyes.treasurefinder.o: I think my Treasury is sufficiently full $looking:
xat.ability.hard_head.name: §6Hard Head
xat.ability.hard_head.tooltip1: When a hit would destroy your head while your torso survives, $chance: chance to restore your head
xat.ability.heavy.name: §cHeavy
xat.ability.heavy.tooltip1: Sinks an extra $sink: blocks/tick in water (not while ground is within $depth: blocks below and your head is above water); boats you ride sink too; no sinking with Skilled Swimmer
xat.ability.heavy.tooltip2: $trample:Walking without sneaking turns farmland within 1 block back into dirt and breaks plants
xat.ability.immunity_cold.name: §bCold §6Immunity
xat.ability.immunity_cold.tooltip1: Core temperature never drops below -$limit: (Cold Sweat deals cold damage from -100)
xat.ability.immunity_dark.name: §8Dark §6Immunity
xat.ability.immunity_dark.tooltip2: Dark damage heals you for $multiplier:x its amount and is reduced by the healed amount
xat.ability.immunity_dark.tooltip3: $heal:$wither: damage heals you instead of hurting
xat.ability.immunity_fire.name: §cFire §6Immunity
xat.ability.immunity_fire.tooltip1: Immune to all fire damage (burning, lava, fireballs...); fire on you is put out instantly
xat.ability.immunity_heat.name: §cHeat §6Immunity
xat.ability.immunity_heat.tooltip1: Core temperature is capped at $limit: (Cold Sweat deals heat damage from 100)
xat.ability.immunity_ice.name: §bIce §6Immunity
xat.ability.immunity_lightning.name: §cLightning §6Immunity
xat.ability.immunity_lightning.tooltip1: Immune to lightning damage; getting struck grants $strike:
xat.ability.immunity_parasites.name: Parasites §6Immunity
xat.ability.immunity_parasites.tooltip1: Immune to $effect: (e.g. from drinking dirty water)
xat.ability.immunity_poison.name: §2Poison §6Immunity
xat.ability.immunity_thirst.name: Thirst Poison §6Immunity
xat.ability.immunity_thirst.tooltip1: Immune to $effect: (e.g. from drinking dirty water)
xat.ability.immunity_water.name: §9Water §6Immunity
xat.ability.large_hands.name: Large Hands
xat.ability.large_hands.tooltip1: Melee hits deal $splash: of the damage to other entities within 1 block of the target
xat.ability.large_hands.tooltip2: Area mining ($mode:): also breaks blocks in a $size:x$size:x$size: area that are no harder than the mined block and suit your tool (blacklist excluded)
xat.ability.large_hands.tooltip3: Mining bare-handed works like a wooden pickaxe / shovel / axe
xat.ability.lightning_bolt.name: §3Lightning Affinity
xat.ability.lightning_bolt.tooltip1: Hold *key: to charge, release to strike up to $range: blocks along your view; entities within 1 block of the impact are hit
xat.ability.lightning_bolt.tooltip2: Full charge takes $charge:s: $damage: damage for $cost: MP; both scale with charge; below $mincharge: charge nothing happens
xat.ability.lightning_bolt.tooltip3: Without enough mana for a full charge, the charge limit drops to your current mana
xat.ability.lightning_bolt.tooltip4: Above $creeper: charge, struck creepers become charged
xat.ability.magnetic.name: Magnetic
xat.ability.magnetic.tooltip1: Press *key: or right-click the item to toggle
xat.ability.magnetic.tooltip2: $instant:While on, picks up items within $horizontal: blocks horizontally and $vertical: vertically instantly
xat.ability.magnetic.tooltip3: While on, pulls items within $horizontal: blocks horizontally and $vertical: vertically with $force: force
xat.ability.magnetic.tooltip4: $xpinstant:Also absorbs experience orbs in range instantly
xat.ability.magnetic.tooltip5: Also pulls experience orbs in range with $xpforce: force
xat.ability.magnetic.tooltip6: Costs $cost: MP every $interval:s while on; turns off when mana runs out
xat.ability.magnetic.tooltip7: Items closer to another player with an active magnet are left to them
xat.ability.mending_bloom.name: §aMending Bloom
xat.ability.mending_bloom.tooltip1: Release *key: to create a healing cloud where you look (up to $range: blocks); casting again replaces the previous cloud
xat.ability.mending_bloom.tooltip2: Radius $radius:, height ±$height:; activates after $wait:s, lasts $duration:s, pulses every $pulse:s
xat.ability.mending_bloom.tooltip3: Each pulse applies $effects: to creatures inside (once per $reapply:s per target)
xat.ability.mending_bloom.tooltip4: Each pulse restores $repair: durability to dropped items inside
xat.ability.mending_bloom.tooltip5: Each pulse grows up to $growth: plants inside
xat.ability.mending_bloom.tooltip6: Costs $total: MP = $persecond: per second of duration + $pereffect: per effect + $perlevel: per effect level
xat.ability.night_vision.name: §eNight Vision
xat.ability.night_vision.tooltip1: Press *key: to toggle; while on grants $nightvision:, paused during $blindness:
xat.ability.night_vision.tooltip2: Costs $cost: MP per second while on; turns off when mana runs out
xat.ability.nullify_kinetic.name: Kinetic Nullification
xat.ability.nullify_kinetic.tooltip1: $immune:Immune to fall, falling block, stalactite and fly-into-wall damage
xat.ability.nullify_kinetic.tooltip2: Fall, falling block, stalactite and fly-into-wall damage x$multiplier:
xat.ability.nullify_kinetic.tooltip3: Each reduction costs $cost: MP; no effect without mana
xat.ability.reduce_kinetic.name: Fall Resistance
xat.ability.reduce_kinetic.tooltip1: $immune:Immune to fall, falling block, stalactite and fly-into-wall damage
xat.ability.reduce_kinetic.tooltip2: Fall, falling block, stalactite and fly-into-wall damage x$multiplier:
xat.ability.reduce_kinetic.tooltip3: Each reduction costs $cost: MP; no effect without mana
xat.ability.repel.name: Repelling Force
xat.ability.repel.tooltip1: Press *aux: + *key: or sneak + right-click the item to toggle
xat.ability.repel.tooltip2: While on, pushes these away with $force: force within $horizontal: blocks horizontally and $vertical: vertically: $targets:
xat.ability.repel.tooltip3: Costs $cost: MP every $interval:s while on; turns off when mana runs out
xat.ability.safe_guard.name: §6Safe Guard
xat.ability.safe_guard.tooltip1: After every $hits: hits of at least $mincount: damage, the next hit of at least $mintrigger: damage is fully blocked and the count resets
xat.ability.safe_guard.tooltip4: Gaining the same effect again adds one level on top, up to level $maxlevel:
xat.ability.skilled_archer.name: Skilled Archer
xat.ability.skilled_archer.tooltip1: Works with bows in the draw weight table ($bows: entries); a full draw takes $draw:s
xat.ability.skilled_archer.tooltip2: Arrow damage x draw factor x$base:; draw factor = bow weight x draw progress / $weight:, at least x$min:
xat.ability.skilled_archer.tooltip3: $soft:The draw factor is raised to the power of 0.75
xat.ability.skilled_archer.tooltip4: Sneaking on release spends mana ($fullcost: MP at full draw, scaled by draw): +x1 by the share paid, +x$mana: more if fully paid (up to x$max:)
xat.ability.skilled_archer.tooltip5: A full draw with full payment explodes on impact (no block damage) with power $power: + $powerscale: x bow weight / $weight:
xat.ability.skilled_miner.name: Skilled Miner
xat.ability.skilled_miner.tooltip1: $fortune:Mining blocks on the fortune list with a pickaxe counts as Fortune $level: (not with Silk Touch)
xat.ability.skilled_miner.tooltip2: $mix:A pickaxe that already has Fortune gets +$level: on top instead
xat.ability.skilled_miner.tooltip3: $tier:Pickaxes can harvest blocks one mining tier higher
xat.ability.skilled_miner.tooltip4: With a pickaxe that can harvest the block, mining speed is at least hardness x $target: and at most hardness x $cap:
xat.ability.skilled_miner.tooltip5: Blocks on the experience list drop $expmin:~$expmax: extra experience when mined with a pickaxe (not with Silk Touch)
xat.ability.skilled_miner.tooltip6: $minexp:Blocks on the minimum list always drop at least 1 extra experience
xat.ability.skilled_rider.name: Skilled Rider
xat.ability.skilled_swimmer.name: Skilled Swimmer
xat.ability.skilled_swimmer.tooltip1: $modern:Move freely in water or lava like flying: movement keys, jump to rise, sneak to dive; no natural sinking
xat.ability.skilled_swimmer.tooltip2: $modern:Swim thrust = base movement speed x swim speed attribute x $speed:; +$strider: per Depth Strider level
xat.ability.skilled_swimmer.tooltip3: $old:Hover when idle; moving forward follows your view pitch (up to $buoyancy: blocks/tick); sneak to sink faster (x$sinkwater: in water, x$sinklava: in lava)
xat.ability.stampede.name: §6Stampede
xat.ability.stampede.tooltip1: Hold *key: to charge in place (up to $charge:s), release to dash horizontally along your view; below $mincharge: charge it is cancelled
xat.ability.stampede.tooltip2: Dash speed $vmin:~$vmax: blocks/tick (scales with charge squared; x$air: in the air)
xat.ability.stampede.tooltip3: Entities in the path take $mindamage:~$damage: damage and are knocked back $knockback: and up $lift: blocks/tick (scale with charge squared)
xat.ability.stampede.tooltip4: Full charge costs $cost: MP, scaled by charge; with less mana the charge limit drops accordingly
xat.ability.vicious_strike.name: §4Vicious Strike
xat.ability.vicious_strike.tooltip1: Melee hits have a $chance: chance to make the target bleed
xat.ability.vicious_strike.tooltip2: Faelis: $bleed: II for $duration:s; other races: $bleed: I for $reduced:s
xat.ability.vicious_strike.tooltip3: $bleed: deals $bleeddamage: x level damage per second; hitting a bleeding target adds the duration and levels (Faelis Claw wearers take no bleed damage)
xat.ability.vicious_strike.tooltip4: $defiled:With Defiled Lands: applies its Bleeding instead, +1 level per hit (+2 for Faelis) up to level $maxlevel:; Faelis $duration:s, others $reduced:s
xat.ability.weightless.name: §dWeightless
xat.ability.weightless.tooltip1: While airborne you ignore gravity and hold your height; swing your arm to rise $speed: blocks/tick, sneak + swing to descend
xat.ability.well_rested.name: §bWell Rested
xat.ability.well_rested.tooltip1: Waking up after a full night's sleep grants: $all:
xat.ability.well_rested.tooltip2: Waking up after a full night's sleep grants $picks: random pick(s) (repeats allowed) from: $random:
xat.ability.wolf_rider.name: Wolf Rider
xat.ability.wolf_rider.tooltip1: Press *key: while looking at your own tamed adult wolf to ride it (within half your block reach)
xat.ability.wolf_rider.tooltip2: While riding, press *key: to make the wolf pounce along your view: 100% of its attack damage to the first target, 50% to the second, 20% to the rest; $cooldown:s cooldown
xat.ability.wolf_rider.tooltip3: While riding you keep $rider: and the wolf keeps $wolf:; your Fire Resistance and Invisibility are shared with the wolf
